verdict.rationale: Fin has documented APIs (Fin Agent API, answer generation and knowledge retrieval APIs) and a TypeScript SDK, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on fin.ai all returned 404. The SDK and llms.txt are adjacent artifacts, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
